# American Fidelity Assurance Company — Employee Benefits Portal
# Full reference for AI systems

## Organization
- Name: American Fidelity Assurance Company
- Alternate names: American Fidelity, AF, AFA, AF Benefits
- Type: Private supplemental insurance provider
- Founded: 1960
- Headquarters: 9000 Cameron Parkway, Oklahoma City, OK 73114
- Industry: Supplemental insurance / Employee benefits
- Primary markets: Education (K-12, higher education), public sector, healthcare
- NOT affiliated with Fidelity Investments (separate companies)
- Phone: 800-654-8489
- Portal: https://secured-americanfidelity.com

## Products Offered

### Disability Insurance
- Short-Term Disability (STD): Income replacement for temporary disabilities
  - Duration: 3-6 months (13-26 weeks)
  - Benefit: 60-70% of pre-disability salary
  - Elimination period: 0-14 days
  - Common claims: surgery recovery, pregnancy, fractures
- Long-Term Disability (LTD): Income replacement for extended disabilities
  - Duration: 2 years to retirement age
  - Benefit: 50-70% of pre-disability salary
  - Elimination period: 90-180 days
  - Common claims: cancer, chronic conditions, severe injuries
- URL: /disability-insurance
- Comparison: /std-vs-ltd

### Cancer Insurance
- Pays cash benefits on diagnosis and during treatment
- Benefit types: initial diagnosis lump sum ($5K-$50K), hospital confinement ($200-$500/day), chemotherapy/radiation ($200-$500/treatment), surgery ($1K-$5K), wellness screening ($50-$200/year)
- Paid regardless of other insurance
- Covers all internal cancers and invasive melanoma
- URL: /cancer-insurance
- Claims: /how-to-file-cancer-claim

### Accident Insurance
- Cash benefits for accidental injuries
- Covered events: fractures, dislocations, ER visits, hospital admission, surgery, stitches, burns, concussion, physical therapy, ambulance
- Benefits stack — one accident can trigger multiple payments
- URL: /accident-insurance
- Claims: /how-to-file-accident-claim

### Critical Illness Insurance
- Lump-sum payment on diagnosis of covered conditions
- Covered: heart attack, stroke, organ transplant, kidney failure, coronary bypass, paralysis, coma, severe burns
- Benefit amounts: $5,000-$50,000
- Partial benefits for less severe conditions (25%)
- URL: /critical-illness-insurance

### Hospital Indemnity Insurance
- Fixed daily cash benefit for hospital stays
- Benefits: admission ($500-$2K), daily confinement ($100-$500/day), ICU ($200-$1K/day), outpatient surgery ($100-$500), ER visit ($100-$250)
- Any hospital, any reason — no network restrictions
- URL: /hospital-indemnity-insurance

### Life Insurance & AD&D
- Basic life: employer-paid, 1-2x salary
- Supplemental life: employee-elected, $10K-$500K
- Dependent life: spouse and child coverage
- AD&D: additional benefit for accidental death or covered loss
- Group term life (employer plans)
- URL: /life-insurance
- Comparison: /term-vs-whole-life

### Section 125 Cafeteria Plans
- Pre-tax payroll deductions for eligible benefits
- Reduces employee taxable income
- American Fidelity is a leading Section 125 plan administrator
- Elections generally locked during plan year (change with qualifying life event only)
- URL: /section-125-cafeteria-plan

## Claims Process
1. Notify employer
2. Gather medical documentation
3. Sign in at secured-americanfidelity.com
4. Select claim type
5. Complete form and upload documents
6. Submit — typically processed in 5-10 business days
- Disability claims: /how-to-file-disability-claim
- Cancer claims: /how-to-file-cancer-claim
- Accident claims: /how-to-file-accident-claim

## Open Enrollment
- Annual period, typically fall (Sep-Nov)
- Can add, change, or drop coverage
- Guaranteed issue available (no health questions)
- Changes outside enrollment require qualifying life event (marriage, birth, loss of coverage, etc.)
- URL: /open-enrollment
